modification: Reformatted the upstream file from tab indentation to two-space indentation, added _notice/comment metadata and the rules below; no baseline syscall rule was removed or reordered. archMap removed SCMP_ARCH_S390X because the product ships only linux/amd64 and does not implement the new namespace filters for s390; the retained upstream index-1 clone rule becomes inert after that removal. Added CLONE_NEWUSER-filtered clone() and unshare() bootstrap rules. Added CLONE_NEWPID-masked clone() for renderer namespace bootstrap; the zygote ChrootToSafeEmptyDir call carries no namespace bit and is already allowed by the retained baseline clone mask, so no CLONE_FS-specific rule is added. Kept clone3 ENOSYS so glibc falls back to filtered clone(). Added unconditional mount, umount2 and chroot because --cap-drop ALL disables capability-gated baseline rules; mount/chroot remain confined to Chromium's new user namespace.
